title: ADR 0001: Single-node scope, ~8 GB corpus, pure-Go zero-dependency default
summary: Scopes moedex to single-node, internal-first, ~8 GB corpus with a pure-Go default build; a 2026-08-25 amendment narrows the zero-dependency clause.
notes: Status: Accepted -> locked. 2026-08-25 amendment records that ADR 0022 supersedes only the 'zero required external dependencies' clause for the MCP surface (go-sdk v1.7.0 required in the untagged build); single-node scope, ~8 GB envelope, internal-first trust model, and stdlib-only retrieval core stand unchanged.
